purpose: Define local authority and data-release checks around MCP calls so external tool/server connectivity never becomes implicit authorization to read local data or perform effects.

topics.name: MCP Permission Boundary
topics.purpose: Define local authority and data-release checks around MCP calls so external tool/server connectivity never becomes implicit authorization to read local data or perform effects.

semantics.local_authority_rule: Every MCP-exposed local call/result source is governed by local capability/authority policy.
semantics.remote_authority_rule: Remote server claims do not override local authorization.
semantics.data_release_rule: Arguments/data sent to MCP are explicitly selected and authorized for release.
semantics.effect_rule: Remote tool invocation effects are represented through the bound local tool semantics.
semantics.visibility_rule: MCP tool visibility in a model/tool list is not permission to invoke it.
semantics.identity_rule: Calling model/user/agent identity remains explicit through the tool invocation context.
semantics.least_scope_rule: Only data required for the explicit invocation is released.

invariants.rule: MCP server identity, transport, tool schema, lifecycle and authority remain explicit and do not inherit trust from connectivity or advertised metadata.

hard_gates.condition: MCP connectivity grants local data access
remote server metadata overrides local authority
unscoped local context sent to MCP by default
caller identity lost at MCP boundary
remote effect bypasses bound local tool semantics

references.purpose: Tool existence and permission remain separate.

prose.summary: Define local authority and data-release checks around MCP calls so external tool/server connectivity never becomes implicit authorization to read local data or perform effects.
